title: E2E tests for guided onboarding checklist progress (step completion, persistence, feature flag)
creator: Leila Farouk
body:
## Context
We shipped the guided onboarding checklist shell + backend state model behind a feature flag. We need end-to-end coverage that:
1) step completion updates appear in the UI when validation signals occur,
2) completion state persists across sessions and across navigation within the Console,
3) feature flag targeting / cohorting behaves as expected (hidden vs visible, and state stability when flag changes).

This is specifically for Phase 1 (Hosted API onboarding checklist) and should focus on high-signal scenarios without becoming flaky due to async validation pipelines.

## Goals
- Catch regressions in checklist progression logic and UI state rendering.
- Catch regressions in persistence (server-side state) across reload/new session.
- Catch regressions in feature flag gating (eligible org vs ineligible org).
- Keep tests stable in CI (avoid depending on real gateway logs/metrics delays).

## Non-goals
- Validating correctness of the gateway-side validators end-to-end against production telemetry.
- Comprehensive coverage of every single checklist step; prioritize “spine” steps and flag behavior.

## Proposed approach
Use Playwright-based E2E tests against the Console, with deterministic test doubles:
- For state persistence: use the real checklist state API (create/read/update) against our E2E test environment.
- For validation-dependent steps: inject/override validator responses via an E2E-only API hook or by seeding the backend with completion events (preferred) so we’re not waiting on gateway log ingestion.
- For feature flags: use the E2E environment admin endpoint to set cohort targeting for the test org OR use the existing internal admin override to toggle per-org eligibility.

## Test matrix (initial)
### A. Flag behavior
1) Ineligible org
- Precondition: org not in cohort, flag off.
- Steps: login -> navigate to Console home / onboarding entry point.
- Assert: checklist entry point is not present OR shows “not available” (match UX spec). No onboarding events emitted beyond normal pageview.

2) Eligible org
- Precondition: org allowlisted or % rollout forced on for org.
- Steps: login -> open checklist.
- Assert: checklist renders with expected default step states (all incomplete) and correct deep links.

3) Flag flip stability
- Precondition: org eligible, complete at least one step.
- Steps: complete a step -> reload -> verify persisted -> flip flag off for org -> reload -> UI gated -> flip flag on -> reload.
- Assert: when flag returns, previous progress is preserved (no reset) unless explicitly reset via admin override.

### B. Step completion UI + persistence
4) Manual completion / server-driven completion rendering
- Precondition: org eligible.
- Steps: open checklist -> trigger backend to mark “API key created” as complete (seed endpoint) -> refresh.
- Assert: step shows complete, timestamp/“Completed” state matches UI spec.

5) Persistence across sessions
- Steps: complete 2 steps -> sign out -> sign in -> navigate back.
- Assert: state persists.

6) Multi-project behavior (minimal coverage)
- Precondition: org with two projects.
- Steps: in Project A mark “first successful request” complete -> switch to Project B.
- Assert: Project B shows incomplete for project-scoped steps; org-scoped steps remain complete (as designed in ENG-23111).

### C. Reset / support tooling (smoke)
7) Admin reset
- Precondition: org eligible with completed steps.
- Steps: use internal admin override -> reset checklist for org/project -> reload.
- Assert: steps return to incomplete; no orphaned state in UI.

## Implementation details
- Add a Playwright test suite: `console/e2e/guided-onboarding/checklist-progress.spec.ts`
- Create helpers:
  - `createTestOrgAndProject()`
  - `setOnboardingFlagEligibility(orgId, enabled)`
  - `seedChecklistState(orgId, projectId, stepId, state)` (or `seedValidationSignal(...)` depending on final API)
  - `getChecklistStateViaAPI()` for assertions when UI is ambiguous.
- Use stable selectors (`data-testid`) for:
  - checklist container
  - per-step row state
  - “Completed” badge
  - “Reset checklist” control (admin only)

## Flakiness mitigations
- Do not wait on async pipelines (gateway logs/metrics) in E2E.
- Prefer direct backend seeding endpoints gated to E2E env.
- Avoid time-based assertions; assert relative state only.
- Ensure tests run serially for a shared org OR create a fresh org per test (preferred; increases runtime).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] CI runs the new suite on PRs touching Console checklist code paths.
- [ ] Covers at least: eligible vs ineligible flag behavior, progress persistence across reload, project-scoped step separation, and admin reset.
- [ ] Tests pass reliably (no intermittent >1% failure over 20 CI runs).
- [ ] Adds/uses `data-testid` selectors rather than brittle text selectors.

## Links
- Initiative: PM-482
- Checklist shell: ENG-23110
- Backend state model: ENG-23111
- Telemetry emit: ENG-23112
- First successful request validator: ENG-23113
- Feature flag targeting: ENG-23118

## QA notes
Primary owner: Leila Farouk (QA automation). Partner for E2E hooks/seed endpoints: Chloe Martin / Hannah Rivera.

If we can’t add a seed endpoint in time, fallback is to mock validator calls at the Console network layer, but that reduces confidence in persistence + state API integration; prefer backend seeding.
comments: 2026-02-12 (Leila Farouk): Drafted test matrix + proposed approach. Key decision: avoid waiting on gateway ingestion for “first success” and “streaming session” validations; need deterministic seeding in E2E env.

2026-02-14 (Hannah Rivera): We can expose an E2E-only endpoint in console-backend to set step state for a given orgId/projectId/stepId. Will gate by env + internal auth. Please specify which steps you need first.
2026-02-18 (Chloe Martin): +1 on seeding state. Let’s ensure we don’t introduce a generic “set any step to complete” endpoint in prod. Keep it strictly behind E2E env flag and route-level protection.
2026-02-21 (Leila Farouk): Added selectors request: we need stable `data-testid` on step rows + completion badge; text-based selectors are too brittle due to copy iteration (DES-113).

2026-02-25 (Leila Farouk): Implemented initial Playwright suite locally: flag eligible/ineligible + persistence across reload. Pending: multi-project coverage and admin reset. Opening PR once seed endpoint lands.
2026-02-27 (Hannah Rivera): Seed endpoint merged to E2E env branch; please rebase. Endpoint: `POST /internal/e2e/onboarding/checklist/seed` (orgId, projectId, stepId, state).

2026-03-02 (Leila Farouk): PR up with 4 tests + CI wiring. Remaining concern: test runtime increased by ~2m due to org creation per test; may optimize via shared org + isolated project per test if needed.
2026-03-03 (Dylan Brooks): Review: looks good. Please add one more assertion for “flag flip stability” (progress preserved when re-enabled) since that’s a common beta support workflow.
